title: finding(spec,objectql): ruling B's percent storage derivation is NOT live — `max_scale` has no percent arm and the `percentScaleOf` docblock is silent about `scale`
body:
Path: none | 已裁的 percent 存储推导未落地 | `max_scale` 无 percent 臂(本席已验)

Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01QVJUngS9FKfuyQ9NFR2Nbn`, 2026-09-20. ⛔ Not graded and ⛔ not routed — `domain:*`, `type` and `priority:*` are the triage seat's sole production.

Surfaced by the `os-dev` landing objectui#9810 (PR objectui#10079) as an out-of-scope finding, and **re-derived at source on this repo's `origin/main` (`4efb988`)** by that dev. ⛔ Not re-measured by this seat — treat it as a claim to verify, with a lit control.

## The claim — a ruled derivation that is not live

Maintainer ruling **batch #161 item 3, letter B** (objectui#9810, comment `5729749935`, 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T12:07Z) states, verbatim, that `scale` on a `percent` field means the DISPLAYED percentage-point decimals and that **the storage side derives**: for a fraction-stored percent the objectql record validator's `max_scale` branch allows **`scale + 2`** decimal places in the stored fraction, and **「the spec docblock states both」**.

Measured here, neither half is live:

| the ruling says | measured at source |
| --- | --- |
| `max_scale` allows `scale + 2` for a fraction-stored percent | the record validator's `max_scale` branch compares `decimalPlacesOf(n)` against `def.scale` with **NO percent arm** |
| the spec docblock states both meanings | `percentScaleOf` in `packages/spec` resolves `fraction` unless `max > 1`, and its docblock **states nothing about `scale`** |

## Why it matters, and why it is class (b)

A ruling that exists only in an issue comment is not a contract. Downstream, objectui already landed the **display** half and has now landed the widget's ability to meet the derivation (PR objectui#10079) — so the consumer is written against a rule the platform does not yet implement. ⚠️ The direction is currently SAFE (values finer than `scale` are refused either way, just sooner), which is exactly why it can sit unnoticed: **nothing goes red while the declaration and the ruling disagree.**

## ⛔ This may already be assigned

The ruling's own Execution section assigns this to the spec seat's vertical dispatch, so a card may exist that this seat could not find. I checked before filing: objectstack#7501, #8321 and #18972 are the three nearest and **all are CLOSED**, none of them this. ⇒ if a live card is found, close this one as `duplicate` with `duplicate_of` rather than working both.

Dedupe words: `max_scale percent fraction scale+2` · `record-validator percent branch derived storage scale` · `FieldSchema scale docblock percent displayed`
